gen-gf-revalia-gf-recursive: Loud, loose and wide-striding, Revalia leads with a open-bottomed g and plenty of space between letters. Recursive follows with strokes that keep one thickness in every direction, which is what makes the pairing hold together.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-roboto-condensed: Expressive from the first glyph, Revalia stretches out with a tall band of letters and short stalks above. Roboto Condensed packs its plain sans lines tight, gliding along like wire beneath that loose, wide-set heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Big, brash and unhurried, Revalia spreads its letters wide and lets that open-curved g hang low. Saira Semi Condensed hums along beneath in a constant weight.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-secular-one: Expressive Revalia strides across the page with widely separated letters and a g that leaves its lower curve open. Secular One gives a longer stretch of text a dense, uniform texture, its big midsection filling the line with no stroke variation.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-smooch-sans: Smooch Sans reads tight and tall, its midline set high and an s that opens generously, with gaps between letters nearly gone. Revalia does the loud, loose showing off while Smooch Sans packs in the words.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Revalia stretches out wide and bold, its tall letters topped with short stalks and its g left open below. Sofia Sans Condensed answers in tight, big-x-height sans-serif, with bowls as heavy as the stems.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-spline-sans-mono: Wide, swaggering and a bit theatrical, Revalia sets its letters far apart with a g that stays open underneath. And Spline Sans Mono keeps a longer passage steady, every fixed-width monospace character carrying the same stroke thickness.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-tiny5: Bold and loose, Revalia strides on widely separated letters with short stalks above a tall band. And Tiny5 keeps a longer passage feeling clean and approachable, its ascenders looking short because the body is so tall.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-truculenta: Approachable Truculenta sits beside the swagger of Revalia, which handles loud, wide-spaced display work while Truculenta packs a compact line. Revalia shouts with its open-curved g; Truculenta keeps its rounded forms open to the side.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-ubuntu: Ubuntu sets a lofty lowercase band below the heading, modern and businesslike. Ubuntu reads smoothly across a longer passage in sans-serif, a quiet foil to Revalia's wide-striding g and stalk-topped letters.
